title: A sign change forces a root
caption: f(x) = x⁵ + 3x − 7 is continuous, with f(1) = −3 below the axis and f(2) = 31 above it. A continuous curve cannot jump, so it crosses y = 0 between: here at x ≈ 1.263.
alt: The curve y = x⁵ + 3x − 7 for x from 0.5 to 2 passing from (1, −3) below the axis up through zero near x = 1.263 to (2, 31).
description: f is a polynomial, so it is continuous everywhere.
By the intermediate value theorem the curve crosses zero somewhere between x = 1 and x = 2.

checks.name: f(1.263) = 0: the root lies between 1 and 2
